_doc: Bolt & Sprocket voice manifest (T-101, tools/voice/import.py): every voiced line id. source tts = the game's runtime text-to-speech (core/vo_manager.gd, no file); human = a recorded take at path (res://audio/vo/<id>.ogg) with the actor, the take id and the file hash; ai_* = ElevenLabs (tools/voice/elevenlabs.py, always marked).
